claim: Six exact good-reduction Frobenius polynomials are converted into geometric function-field Mordell--Weil rank upper bounds for each of the four record-specific singleton twists.

method.arithmetic_diagnostic_boundary: the recorded +p multiplicities and component cycles are not used as rank bounds because the arithmetic action on the six toric complement classes has not been identified
method.full_H2: primitive degree 28 plus a six-dimensional algebraic toric complement; its exact arithmetic Frobenius action is not assumed
method.geometric_bound: primitive p-times-root-of-unity multiplicity plus six, minus the degree-10 geometric trivial lattice
method.trivial_lattice: geometrically U plus two D4 root lattices

proof_boundary: Cycle classes give unconditional geometric upper bounds; equality with analytic orders is not assumed. Exact characteristic-zero rank still requires matching known-section lower bounds and saturation.
